logs.title: Model Pipeline Architecture & Dataset Balancing
logs.author: Md Mahamudul Hasan
highlights: Configured remote GPU compute cluster for automated batch training runs.
Constructed data augmentation pipeline with synthetic balancing techniques.
Established baseline evaluation metrics (Precision, Recall, ROC-AUC, F1-Score).

logs.title: Supervisor Consultation & Methodology Gap Analysis
logs.author: Md Sabbir Hossen
highlights: Conducted Week 03 progress consultation with FYDP supervisor.
Addressed feedback on cross-dataset validation and feature extraction depth.
Refined technical deliverables and individual member task assignments.

logs.title: Literature Review & Taxonomy Matrix Finalization
logs.author: Tania Islam
highlights: Surveyed 20+ recent IEEE, ACM, and Springer publications (2022–2026).
Constructed taxonomy comparison matrix identifying critical baseline shortcomings.
Drafted preliminary Related Works section for final FYDP thesis report.

logs.title: FYDP Team Inception & Proposal Defense Approval
logs.author: Maria Tasnim
highlights: Formed Team Random and mapped specialized member technical roles.
Finalized project domain scope, problem statement, and defense slide deck.
Received formal approval from UIU CSE Project & Thesis Committee.
